annual.label: Average yearly repair and maintenance cost

maint.note: YourMechanic charges about $164 for a comparable pickup (2015 GMC Canyon); the Hemi takes about 7 quarts, so parts run higher. The 3.0L EcoDiesel needs a special diesel-rated synthetic oil and costs more.
YourMechanic: about $331–$335 for front pads on 2019–2022 Ram 1500 Classic; shops and dealers $373–$499. Rotors add more if they are worn.
YourMechanic: about $331–$342 for rear pads on 2019–2023 Ram 1500 Classic; shops and dealers $373–$506. Some older trucks use rear drum brakes instead.
YourMechanic average $388 ($248 parts); its 2019–2023 Ram 1500 Classic quotes run $641–$746. Start-stop trucks need an AGM battery; eTorque models also have a separate 48V battery.

maint.every: About every 100,000 miles on newer engines
maint.note: YourMechanic: $669–$746 on 2019–2021 Ram 1500 Classic (3.6L V6 and 5.7L Hemi); shops and dealers $753–$1,184. The 5.7L Hemi has two plugs per cylinder (16 total).
YourMechanic: $377–$595 depending on engine (2011–2022 Ram 1500); shops and dealers $419–$979.
